name: @cycraft/run-ts
description: 🏃🏼 A package that allows to run node scripts written in TypeScript directly.

scripts.release: pnpm run lint && pnpm test && bumpp --no-push && pnpm publish --no-git-checks && git push --follow-tags && gh release create $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0) --generate-notes --notes "$(git log --pretty='- %s  %h' $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 HEAD~1 2>/dev/null || git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD)..HEAD~1)"
